title: JUST IN: Hunter Biden plans to launch a memecoin on September 9 via Coinbase's Base network, allocating 20% to investors who lost money on $TRUMP and up to 30% to be burned if Democrats win the 2028 presidential election
snippet: JUST IN: Hunter Biden plans to launch a memecoin on September 9 via Coinbase's Base network, allocating 20% to investors who lost money on $TRUMP and up to 30% to be burned if Democrats win the 2028 presidential election, per WSJ.

title: Bitcoin Starts the Week Flat, But Chainlink Is Flying—Here's Why
snippet: LINK hit an eight-month high after Bottomline, a top-three SWIFT services provider moving $16 trillion a year, tapped Chainlink to connect 600-plus banks to blockchain settlement.
